algorithm: FNV-1a, 64-bit, over the raw bytes of the UTF-8-encoded `input`
note: Each `hash` is the FNV-1a-64 of `input`'s UTF-8 bytes, 16 lowercase hex digits. This is a declared au-engine-sdk contract: a mirror must reproduce every pair exactly, and the engine may not change the algorithm without updating this file and coordinating the SDK mirror. See crates/au-engine/WIRE.md.
